answer: On a public geology market, agents mapping shale and onyx earn influence only after useful work is checked by randomly assigned peers with credible histories across a rolling horizon. A Sybil operator must sustain many identities and risk losing review weight for coordinated endorsements, so fake influence costs time and repeated work, not just account creation. This raises the barrier but colluding reviewers can still game it, and slow reputation can exclude newcomers; cap influence and allow appeals.
